brief:
An Israeli strike hit tents housing displaced families in the Al-Mawasi area of Khan Younis in southern Gaza, injuring children, Eye on Palestine reported. The strike targeted the informal settlement where Palestinians have taken shelter amid the conflict.

Al-Mawasi has served as a refuge for thousands of displaced civilians throughout the Gaza crisis. The area has faced repeated military operations despite its designation as a humanitarian zone.

title: Israeli strike injures children in Khan Younis displacement camp
